# Data contracts of the market-data pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). ## CRV: Interest rate curve (`ir-curve`)

Discounting (OIS), projection (IBOR/term RFR), government or basis curve for a currency.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [ir-curve.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/market-data/contracts/ir-curve.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | md-hub |
| Grain | One row per interest rate curve per business date, keyed by CURVE_ID. |
| Key | `CURVE_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^CRV-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Storage | connector `market-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/market/ir-curve/` |
| Test data | data/testdata/market-data/ir-curve |
| Worked example | [market-data/ir-curve](../samples/market-data/ir-curve.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CURVE_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `CRV-AUD-BASIS` (pattern `^CRV-`) |  |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required |  | The curve's currency, ISO 4217. | `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` |  |
| `CURVE_TYPE` | text | required |  | What the curve is for: Discount (OIS), Projection, Government or Cross-currency basis. | `Cross-currency basis`, `Discount (OIS)`, `Government`, `Projection` |  |
| `INDEX` | text | required |  | The overnight rate the currency's curves are built on (SOFR, ESTR, SONIA, TONA, SARON, AONIA, CORRA). | `AONIA`, `CORRA`, `ESTR`, `SARON`, `SOFR`, `SONIA`, `TONA` |  |
| `TEN_Y` | amount | required | fraction | The 10-year zero rate, as a fraction (0.0422 is 4.22%). | `0.042199999999999994` |  |
| `SLOPE_2S_10S` | amount | required | bp | The 10-year zero rate minus the 2-year, in basis points. | `51.2` |  |
| `AS_OF` | date | required |  | The date the curve was built for (the business date). | `2026-09-30` |  |
| `POINTS` | record list | required |  | The curve's pillars, shortest tenor first: one object per tenor (1M to 30Y). |  |  |
| `FORWARDS` | record list | required |  | One-year forward rates starting at each tenor (1Y to 20Y): one object per start tenor. |  |  |
| `INTERPOLATION` | text | required |  | How the curve interpolates between pillars (e.g. Log-linear on discount factors). | `Log-linear on discount factors` |  |
| `DAY_COUNT` | text | required |  | The day-count convention of the zero rates (e.g. ACT/365F). | `ACT/365F` |  |
| `CALENDAR` | id | required |  | The curve's holiday calendar: a CALENDAR_ID of the core pack's calendar kind (CAL-…). | `CAL-GBLO` (pattern `^CAL-`) | `calendar` |
| `FIXING_INDEX` | id | required |  | The overnight index's fixings: an INDEX_ID of the market-data pack's rate-fixing kind (FIX-…). | `FIX-AONIA` (pattern `^FIX-`) | `rate-fixing` |
| `BUILT_AT` | timestamp | required |  | When the curve was built, ISO-8601 UTC. | `2026-09-30T18:02:41Z` |  |
| `SOURCES` | text list | required |  | The quote sources the curve was built from. |  |  |

**Nested `POINTS[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TENOR` | text | required |  | The pillar's tenor (1M .. 30Y). | `1M` |  |
| `MATURITY` | date | required |  | The pillar's maturity date: the record's date plus the tenor. | `2026-10-30` |  |
| `INSTRUMENT` | text | required |  | The instrument quoted at the pillar (e.g. SOFR OIS, Deposit / future, Gilt benchmark, Basis swap). | `Deposit / future` |  |
| `QUOTE` | amount | required | fraction | The pillar instrument's par rate, as a fraction a year (0.0328 is 3.28%). | `0.035983` |  |
| `ZERO_RATE` | rate | required | percent | The continuously compounded zero rate to the pillar, in percent (3.2869 is 3.2869%). | `3.6037` |  |
| `DF` | amount | required | factor | The discount factor to the pillar's maturity (exp of minus zero rate times years). | `0.997001` |  |

**Nested `FORWARDS[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TENOR` | text | required |  | The start of the 1-year forward period, from the record's date (1Y .. 20Y). | `10Y`, `15Y`, `1Y`, `20Y`, `2Y`, `3Y`, `5Y`, `7Y` |  |
| `RATE` | rate | required | percent | The 1-year forward rate starting at the tenor, in percent. | `3.7737` |  |

**Links:** `CALENDAR` → `calendar`, `FIXING_INDEX` → `rate-fixing`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `CURVE_ID`, `CURRENCY`, `CURVE_TYPE`, `INDEX`, `TEN_Y`, `SLOPE_2S_10S`, `AS_OF`, `POINTS`, `FORWARDS`, `INTERPOLATION`, `DAY_COUNT`, `CALENDAR`, `FIXING_INDEX`, `BUILT_AT`, `SOURCES`
- unique: key `CURVE_ID`; per business_date
- pattern: field CURVE_ID; pattern ^CRV-
- enum: field CURRENCY; values `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD`
- enum: field CURVE_TYPE; values `Cross-currency basis`, `Discount (OIS)`, `Government`, `Projection`
- enum: field INDEX; values `AONIA`, `CORRA`, `ESTR`, `SARON`, `SOFR`, `SONIA`, `TONA`
- link: field CALENDAR; kind calendar
- link: field FIXING_INDEX; kind rate-fixing
- enum: field FORWARDS[].TENOR; values `10Y`, `15Y`, `1Y`, `20Y`, `2Y`, `3Y`, `5Y`, `7Y`

**Notes**

- Dated by the lake's business_date partition: `drishti.py lake build` writes each test-data file's day into it; the documents carry no date field of their own.

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PAIR` | id | required |  | The record's id: FX- and the pair, base then quote currency (FX-AUDUSD). | `FX-AUDUSD` (pattern `^FX-`) |  |
| `PAIR_NAME` | text | required |  | The pair as people write it, BASE/QUOTE (EUR/USD). | `AUD/USD` |  |
| `MID` | amount | required | quote currency per base | The mid spot rate: units of the quote currency per one unit of the base (the last HISTORY point). | `0.661` |  |
| `BID` | amount | required | quote currency per base | The bid spot rate, in quote currency per one unit of the base. | `0.66097` |  |
| `ASK` | amount | required | quote currency per base | The ask (offer) spot rate, in quote currency per one unit of the base. | `0.66103` |  |
| `CHANGE_1D` | amount | required | fraction | The day's move of MID, as a fraction (-0.01092 is -1.092%). | `-0.01092` |  |
| `SPOT_DATE` | date | required |  | The spot value date: two business days after the data's date (T+2). | `2026-10-02` |  |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The daily mids, oldest first: one object per business day. |  |  |
| `CONVENTIONS` | record | required |  | The pair's market conventions: base and quote currency, pip factor, spot lag, settlement calendars, NDF or not. |  |  |
| `FX_FORWARD_CURVE` | id | required |  | Its forward curve: a CURVE_ID of the market-data pack's fx-forward-curve kind (FXF-…). | `FXF-AUDUSD` (pattern `^FXF-`) | `fx-forward-curve` |
| `FX_VOL_SURFACE` | id | required |  | Its volatility surface: a SURFACE_ID of the market-data pack's fx-vol-surface kind (FXV-…). | `FXV-AUDUSD` (pattern `^FXV-`) | `fx-vol-surface` |

**Nested `HISTORY[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DATE` | date | required |  | A business day of the mid-rate history, oldest first, ending at the record's date. | `2026-08-19` |  |
| `MID` | amount | required | quote currency per base | The mid rate that day: units of the quote currency per one unit of the base currency. | `0.69653` |  |

**Nested `CONVENTIONS`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BASE` | text | required |  | The base currency (the one quoted per unit), ISO 4217. | `AUD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `USD` |  |
| `QUOTE` | text | required |  | The quote (price) currency, ISO 4217. | `USD` |  |
| `PIP_FACTOR` | integer | required |  | Pips per unit of the rate: 10000, or 100 for a JPY pair (forward points are rate differences times it). | `10000` |  |
| `SPOT_LAG` | text | required |  | The pair's spot settlement lag (T+2). | `T+2` |  |
| `CALENDAR` | id | required |  | The settlement calendars, joined by + (GBLO+USNY); not a CALENDAR_ID, although the contract links it to calendar. | `GBLO+USNY` | `calendar` |
| `NDF` | boolean | required |  | true when the pair trades as a non-deliverable forward (USDINR, USDBRL, USDKRW). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `FX_FORWARD_CURVE` → `fx-forward-curve`, `FX_VOL_SURFACE` → `fx-vol-surface`, `CONVENTIONS.CALENDAR` → `calendar`.

## CORRC: Correlations of a factor set (computed from price history) (`correlation-result`)

The pairwise correlations of a correlation set's factors, computed when asked from their daily closes in the lake (log returns over a window, Pearson or Ledoit-Wolf) by the server's Java engine, as the person asking; never stored.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [correlation-result.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/market-data/contracts/correlation-result.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | computed |
| Status | active |
| Source | computed by Drishti: the reactive connector correlation-engine (java engine com.ash.drishti.compute.reactive.analytics.CorrelationEngine) |
| Grain | One answer per question (the correlation set asked for, its window and estimator, and the business date), computed when asked. |
| Key | — |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `on request` |
| Cadence | on change (due: computed on request and again when the correlation sets, equities or FX spots load (data-version trigger)) |
| Storage | connector `correlation-engine` (plugin `reactive`) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MATRIX_ID` | id | required |  | The correlation set asked for (the id; parameters ride on it as CORR-EU-EQ~window=20~estimator=ledoit-wolf) | `CORR-EU-EQ` |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The set's name |  |  |
| `FACTORS` | id list | required |  | The factors' market-data ids, equities first (EQUITY_IDS, then FX_IDS) |  |  |
| `ESTIMATOR` | text | required |  | The estimator used (parameter estimator, default pearson) | `pearson`, `ledoit-wolf` |  |
| `WINDOW` | integer | required |  | The daily log returns used (parameter window; 0, the default, or a window longer than the history uses every return) |  |  |
| `AVAILABLE` | integer | required |  | The returns the factors' common dates allow (the dates every factor has, less one) |  |  |
| `FROM` | date | required |  | The first close of the window |  |  |
| `TO` | date | required |  | The last close of the window |  |  |
| `AVERAGE` | rate | required |  | The mean of the pairwise correlations |  |  |
| `MIN_RHO` | rate | required |  | The lowest pairwise correlation |  |  |
| `MAX_RHO` | rate | required |  | The highest pairwise correlation |  |  |
| `SHRINKAGE` | rate | optional |  | Ledoit-Wolf only, the shrinkage intensity toward no correlation (0 none, 1 all the way) |  |  |
| `PAIRS` | record list | required |  | Nested: see nested PAIRS[] |  |  |
| `FACTOR_STATS` | record list | required |  | Nested: see nested FACTOR_STATS[] |  |  |

**Nested `PAIRS[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `A` | id | required |  | The first factor |  |  |
| `B` | id | required |  | The second factor |  |  |
| `RHO` | rate | required |  | Their correlation, to four decimals |  |  |

**Nested `FACTOR_STATS[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FACTOR` | id | required |  | — |  |  |
| `LAST` | amount | required |  | The last close of the window |  |  |
| `RETURN` | rate | required |  | The simple return over the window (a fraction) |  |  |
| `VOLATILITY` | rate | required |  | The standard deviation of the daily log returns times the square root of 252 (a fraction) |  |  |

**Validation**

- required: fields `AVERAGE`, `PAIRS`, `WINDOW`

**Notes**

- No stored key: an answer's id is the question asked, the id of the correlation set (correlation-matrix) it reads.
- Errors are said in words (an engine refusal): no such set, fewer than two factors, a factor without price history, fewer than three common dates, a price of zero or less, a factor that did not move over the window, an estimator other than pearson or ledoit-wolf.

## EQB: An equity's beta against its index (computed from price history) (`equity-beta`)

An equity's beta, alpha, correlation and R squared against its index (EQUITY_INDEX), the regression of their daily log returns over a window, computed when asked from both price histories by the server's Java engine, as the person asking; never stored. It replaces the security master's stored BETA (retired in 2.9.2).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [equity-beta.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/market-data/contracts/equity-beta.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | computed |
| Status | active |
| Source | computed by Drishti: the reactive connector equity-analytics (java engine com.ash.drishti.compute.reactive.analytics.BetaEngine) |
| Grain | One answer per question (the equity asked for, its window and the business date), computed when asked. |
| Key | — |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `on request` |
| Cadence | on change (due: computed on request and again when the equities or indices load (data-version trigger)) |
| Storage | connector `equity-analytics` (plugin `reactive`) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EQUITY` | id | required |  | The equity asked for (the id; the window rides on it as EQ-NVTK~window=20) | `EQ-NVTK` |  |
| `INDEX` | id | required |  | The index it is measured against (the equity's EQUITY_INDEX) |  |  |
| `WINDOW` | integer | required |  | The daily returns used (parameter window; 0, the default, or a window longer than the history uses every return) |  |  |
| `AVAILABLE` | integer | required |  | The returns the two histories' common dates allow |  |  |
| `FROM` | date | required |  | — |  |  |
| `TO` | date | required |  | — |  |  |
| `BETA` | rate | required |  | cov(r, r_index) / var(r_index) of the daily log returns |  |  |
| `ALPHA` | rate | required |  | The regression's intercept, a daily log return |  |  |
| `CORRELATION` | rate | required |  | — |  |  |
| `R_SQUARED` | rate | required |  | — |  |  |
| `VOLATILITY` | rate | required |  | The equity's sample standard deviation of the daily log returns x sqrt(252), a fraction |  |  |
| `INDEX_VOLATILITY` | rate | required |  | The index's, the same way |  |  |

**Validation**

- required: fields `BETA`, `INDEX`, `WINDOW`

**Notes**

- No stored key: an answer's id is the question asked, the id of the equity it reads.
- Errors are said in words (an engine refusal): no such equity, an equity that names no index, an index without price history, fewer than three common dates, an index that did not move over the window.
